engine.name: Vapour Engine
engine.runtime: Rust/WebAssembly core with a TypeScript host

conventions.sceneFormat: deterministic JSON with stable UUID asset references
conventions.errorPolicy: invalid input throws with an actionable message rather than propagating NaN

packages.name: @vapour/assetgen
packages.description: Declarative, AI-authorable 2D and 3D asset generation for Vapour Engine

packages.name: @vapour/engine
packages.description: Browser host and TypeScript gameplay SDK for Vapour Engine

packages.name: @vapour/gameplay
packages.description: Gameplay framework for Vapour Engine: inventory, crafting, combat, status effects, and narrative

packages.name: @vapour/math
packages.description: Shared linear algebra, easing, curves, gradients, and geometry for Vapour Engine

packages.name: @vapour/net
packages.description: Authoritative multiplayer for Vapour Engine: replication, RPCs, prediction, and interest management

packages.name: @vapour/three-bridge
packages.description: Three.js scene migration bridge for Vapour Engine's WebGPU renderer

subsystems.summary: Game framework utilities.

subsystems.summary: XR: WebXR sessions, tracking, and locomotion.
